Desc: Fires a large cone of flame for 3 seconds in a random direction. Objects hit by this cone are considered On Fire for the duration and are Ignited. Flammable is not consumed while the cone is active. 20 second cooldown.

Fires a large cone of flame for 5 seconds in a random direction. Objects hit by this cone are considered On Fire for the duration and are Ignited. Flammable is not consumed while the cone is active. 20 second cooldown.
Fires a disk that bounces between components 5 times, Freezing each of them. 5 second cooldown. +: Disk bounces 10 times.

Fires a disk that bounces between components 10 times, Freezing each of them. This does not activate the components unless they are already Frozen, in which case they are activated and Frozen is reapplied. 5 second cooldown.
Throws two explosives near an active ball that Detonate with a medium area of effect. 7 second cooldown. +: Expanded area of effect.
Throws two explosives near an active ball with a large area of effect. 7 second cooldown.
Projects 4 Holoballs originating from an active ball that persist for 2.5 seconds. 8 second cooldown. +: Projection increased to 8 Holoballs.
Projects 8 Holoballs originating from an active ball that persist for 2.5 seconds. 8 second cooldown.
Fires a burst of three consecutive beams (one after the other, not all at once) that each activate a random component. 3 second cooldown. +: Cooldown reduced to 1.5 seconds.
Fires a burst of three consecutive beams (one after the other, not all at once) that each activate a random component. 1.5 second cooldown.
